item.title: Land sacrificed, dreams deferred: Angul villagers allege betrayal over unfulfilled job promises at aluminium park
item.description: Residents of three villages in Odisha’s Angul district have alleged betrayal over unfulfilled promises of jobs and training linked to the aluminium park project at Tulasipala panchayat. In 2012, around 199 acres of land were acquired in two phases by the Odisha Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation (IDCO) for the establishment of the aluminium park. item.title: Odisha Revenue Inspector attacked by sand mafia during raid in Balasore
item.description: A Revenue Inspector (RI) was allegedly attacked by sand mafia while conducting a raid against illegal sand extraction unit in Odisha's Balasore on Friday. The incident occurred under Baliapal tehsil when Srirampur RI Sarojini Tudu acted on information regarding unlawful sand lifting at Palpada on the Subarnarekha river. item.title: Speeding van rams into e-auto in Bhubaneswar, 4 injured
item.description: Four persons were injured after a speeding traveller van rammed into a battery-operated e-auto in Bhubaneswar’s Badagada area on Friday morning. The accident occurred around 9.10 am on the main road near Brit Colony under the jurisdiction of Badagada police station. According to eyewitnesses, the traveller van was moving at high speed when it collided head-on with the e-auto, severely damaging the vehicle.
